title: Vintage Gibson SG Special Value Guide: P-90s And More
description: Read how P-90 and mini-humbucker eras, original finishes and repairs affect vintage SG Special value. Joe explains the comparisons behind an appraisal.
h1: Vintage Gibson SG Special Value Guide
alt: Cherry Gibson SG Special with two black P-90 pickups, a large pickguard and short vibrato

faqs.q: How Much Is A Vintage Gibson SG Special Worth?
faqs.a: The range depends on the exact era, original finish, pickups, repair history and included case. The clean-original bands in this draft are still under review, so I haven't supplied an unsupported dollar figure. I can begin an individual appraisal from photographs and the history you know.

faqs.q: Can I Use A Dealer Asking Price As My Guitar's Value?
faqs.a: An asking price is the amount a seller requests. It isn't a verified completed sale or a promise of what another guitar will bring. I compare completed results with matching condition details and keep advertised prices separate.

faqs.q: Does A Quality Refret Change The Collector Category?
faqs.a: A quality refret is accepted maintenance and preserves the all-original classification of an otherwise all-original guitar. It takes the instrument out of the museum-quality category. Neck reshaping is a separate alteration.

faqs.q: Should I Replace Parts Before Requesting An Appraisal?
faqs.a: Start by documenting the guitar as it is. Keep removed original parts with it and describe known changes. I don't need you to reinstall parts or authorize cosmetic work before the initial appraisal.
